Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique code identifying the reporting counterparty of the contract.

Nature.name: Nature
Nature.definition: Indicates if the reporting counterparty is a central counterparty, a financial, non-financial counterparty or other type of counterparty in accordance with regulation.

TradingCapacity.name: Trading Capacity
TradingCapacity.definition: Identifies the trading capacity of the seller.

DirectionOrSide.name: Direction Or Side
DirectionOrSide.definition: Indicates the direction or side of the derivative transaction from the perspective of the reporting counterparty. ||Usage:|CounterpartySide should be used for the instruments such as most forwards and forward-like contracts (except for foreign exchange forwards and foreign exchange non-deliverable forwards); most options and option-like contracts including swaptions, caps and floors; credit default swaps; variance, volatility and correlation swaps; contracts for difference and spreadbets.

TraderLocation.name: Trader Location
TraderLocation.definition: Location of the trading desk or trader responsible for the decision of entering into or execution of the transaction.

BookingLocation.name: Booking Location
BookingLocation.definition: Location of the trade party or the branch/office of the trade party to which the transaction is booked.

ReportingExemption.name: Reporting Exemption
ReportingExemption.definition: Provides details on the reporting exemption of a counterparty.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
